title: SSE channel Full/Closed split: explicit match is correct and should be defended
description: The new match on TrySendError::Full vs TrySendError::Closed at events.rs line 432 is the right design. Full = client is alive but stalled; Closed = client disconnected. Conflating them (the old is_err() form) made it impossible to emit a warn log only for stalled clients. A future contributor might suggest 'simplify back to is_err()' to reduce boilerplate — this should be resisted because the two cases have different operational meanings and the distinction enables correct observability (warn on Full, silent drop on Closed).
